% Table of contents entries that \addcontentsline adds beside unnumbered
% headings: before one, after one with text or a blank line after it, and
% after a numbered heading, before the unnumbered one it names. The
% filler lets each heading scroll to the top of the window.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Before}
\section*{Before}
Text. \lipsum[1-6]

\section*{After}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{After}
Text right after. \lipsum[1-6]

\section*{Blank}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Blank}

Text after a blank line. \lipsum[1-6]

\section{Results}
\addcontentsline{toc}{subsection}{Overview}
\subsection*{Overview}
Text. \lipsum[1-6]
\end{document}
